params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Xerath}} next basic attack restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}, doubled against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Xerath''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} to restore {{sti|mana|{{pp|27 + 3*x for 3; then +6*x for 3; then +9*x for 4; then +12*x for 5; then +15*x for 5|formula=27 + 3 at each level up to 3, then + 6 at each level up to 6, then + 9 at each level up to 10, 12 at each level up to 15, then + 15 at each level|color=mana}} {{as|mana}}}}, doubled to {{pp|54 + 6*x for 3; then +12*x for 3; then +18*x for 4; then +24*x for 5; then +30*x for 5|formula=54 + 6 at each level up to 3, then + 12 at each level up to 6, then + 18 at each level up to 10, then + 24 at each level up to 15, then + 30 at each level|color=mana}} against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description2: ''Mana Surge's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|3.5}} seconds whenever '''Xerath''' kills an enemy.
params.description3: ''Mana Surge does not trigger if '''Xerath''' would restore above {{as|his '''maximum''' mana}}.''
params.notes:
* ''Mana Surge'' will trigger even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}, but not if it misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Mana Surge's '' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}} effects.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xerath}} {{tip|channel|charges}} up to a short time, increasing the {{sti|range}} of his beam.
params.blurb2: ''Arcanopulse'' can be recast within the duration and will cancel automatically afterwards, refunding half the {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} After a brief delay, '''Xerath'''  fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|0;10;15;20;25;30;35;40|0 to 1.75|formula=10% after 0 to 0.25 seconds, then {{plus}}5% per 0.25 seconds channeled, capped at 40%}} for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Arcanopulse's'' {{sti|range}} over the first {{fd|1.5}} to {{fd|1.75}} seconds of the channel.
params.description2: ''Arcanopulse'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Arcanopulse'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|half the mana cost}}}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Xerath''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{rutngt|0.5}} and afterwards fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{pp|type=channel time|700 to 1450 for 8|0 to 1.75|formula=735 {{plus}} 107.14 per 0.25 seconds (after an intial delay of 0 to 0.25). ''This is capped at 1450 range.''}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xerath}} casts down a blast of energy that strikes the target location after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit. The effects are increased against enemies in the epicenter.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' casts down a blast of arcane energy that strikes the target location after {{rutngt|0.5}}, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 25% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.description2: Enemies in the epicenter take {{fd|66.7}}% increased damage and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by a greater amount, decaying to 25% over the duration.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xerath}} fires an orb of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them based on travel distance.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' fires an orb of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{pp|type=orb travel distance|0.75 to 2.25 for 11|0 to 1050|formula=0.75+(0.15 per 105 units). ''This is capped at 1050 units traveled.''}} seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xerath}} {{tip|channel|channels}} up to a period, being able to fire several arcane missiles across the surrounding area.
params.blurb2: If ''Rite of the Arcane'' ends without using any recasts, half of the cooldown is {{sti|cdr|refunded}}.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast - Arcane Barrage:}} '''Xerath''' catapults an arcane missile to the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Hitting enemy champions increases the damage of the following missiles, up to a cap.
params.blurb4: ''Rite of the Arcane's'' range is always {{tip|obscured|visible}} to both allies and enemies. After catapulting the first missile, '''Xerath''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} himself while there are enemy {{tip|champions}} within ''Rite of the Arcane's'' range.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xerath''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, gaining the ability to recast ''Rite of the Arcane'' multiple times after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration. If ''Rite of the Arcane'' ends without any of the recasts being used, half of its {{sti|cooldown}} is refunded.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast - Arcane Barrage:}} '''Xerath''' catapults an arcane missile that strikes the target location after a {{rutngt|0.6}} delay, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of {{rutngt|0.6}}. After catapulting the first missile, '''Xerath''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} himself while there are enemy {{tip|champions}} within ''Rite of the Arcane's'' range.
params.description3: Hitting at least one enemy champion grants a stack of ''Arcane Perfection'' during the channel, stacking up to a maximum amount. Each stack increases ''Arcane Barrage's'' damage.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Maximum Stacks|{{ap|3 to 5}}}}
{{st|Increased Damage per Stack|{{ap|20 to 30 3}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}}}
params.description4: When there are no enemy {{tip|champions}} nearby, '''Xerath''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} himself for a couple of seconds if a missile strikes within a distance of an enemy unit.
params.notes:
* Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Arcane Barrage'' will not apply its increased damage per stack to the cast that granted the stack.
** Only successive casts of the ability will benefit from the damage increase.
* A circular indicator will be displayed at the target location to signify that the area will be blasted.
* The circle indicating the ability's range expands rapidly from near '''Xerath''' up to the maximum range over 1 second during the channel.
** The maximum-range indicator is visible to both allies and enemies and is color coded for friendly (blue) or hostile (red).
* ''Rite of the Arcane'' uses a [[Champion ability|barrage system]] so that it can be recast multiple times within a given period at no additional cost.
* '''Xerath''' will turn to face toward the direction of the target location after using a recast.
* '''Xerath''' gains a wider field of view during ''Rite of the Arcane''.
* '''Xerath''' can use {{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}} while channeling.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Xerath''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** {{si|Teleport}} and {{si|Recall}} are disabled for the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds and otherwise interrupt the channel if they are used.
